About

Hi, I'm Anil, a digital marketer and web developer based in Gurugram, India. I studied electrical engineering, trained in front-end web development, and moved into in-house digital marketing and web work.

I plan campaigns across Meta, Google Ads and YouTube, write content and ad copy, improve SEO, and build websites and dashboards. I use ChatGPT and Claude every day for research, ideas and code, and I always check and refine what they produce.

Whenever a task repeats, I try to turn it into a simple tool.
